Subject: Re: accepting mail for ""@domain.com

Aaron Bennett:
> Ralf Hildebrandt wrote:
> >   
> > "" = mailer-daemon: = postmaster = root = fuucfyl@clarku.edu jgiangrande@clarku.edu>
> >   
> 
> understood, I got that out of the logs... but why does  "" = mailer-daemon?
> 
> 
> It's more of a curiosity at this point...

Symmetry. 

When the mail system SENDS a delivery status notification it uses
the RFC 2821 null envelope sender address, and MAILER-DAEMON in
the From:  header. Thus, Postfix sends mail FOR the null address
to MAILER-DAEMON (i.e the default value of empty_address_recipient).

	Wietse
